Start2.text:
Scobby: [Wake up, you lazy shit, it's time to spar. You're gonna die out there if you don't learn how to fight properly.]

You wake up from your sleeping bag and look around. You see Lucid writing his journal on a tree, and Scobby poking you with a sparring stick.

opt.text: Time for some sparring, I guess.
I already know all the basics of fighting.

Sparring Prepare.text:
Scobby: [Now, the basics.]

Scobby: [First, let's learn about the skill 'Disengage'. When you disengage, you are staying outside the enemy's attack range, and they will have to spend a turn to engage before attacking you.]

Scobby: [However, when you are disengaged, you may still be attacked by ranged attacks. This goes for you, too. If you want to use a bow or any ranged attacks, you are going to have to be disengaged first. Let's begin.]

opt.text: I already know all the basics of fighting.

Sparring.text: Scobby: [No offense, but you are pretty weak...]

opt.text: I already know all the basics of fighting.
